description: List the features your tracked competitors market on their sites that YOUR site doesn't mention, ranked by how many rivals have each one. For every gap you get each rival's own label and description for the capability. Two uses: (1) find missing features worth building — majority_of_rivals: true flags table stakes; (2) find features you already have but under-market — a gap you know you ship means your site isn't selling it, and the rival descriptions show how others position it.

category.description: Filter to one category: core_workflow, collaboration, integrations, automation, analytics_reporting, ai_capabilities, security_compliance, administration, developer_api, mobile_platform, other

name: outmano_get_feature_gaps

aligned_rival_count.description: Rivals whose features are mapped onto the catalog

labels.description: The rival's own names for the capability

majority_of_rivals.description: True when at least half of the aligned rivals market it

rivals_with_count.description: How many aligned rivals market it
